# Timewheel

> Timewheel (Timewheel Internet Pvt. Ltd.) is a Nagpur-based digital partner that builds and grows businesses online: websites, web apps, SEO, digital marketing, ads and social, on self-hosted systems you own rather than rented SaaS platforms.

Based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Serving clients across India and worldwide.
Contact: hello@timewheel.co.in
Sitemap: https://timewheel.co.in/sitemap.xml

## Services
- [Digital Marketing Company in Nagpur (paid ads focus)](https://timewheel.co.in/digital-marketing-company-in-nagpur): ROI-focused paid ads, SEO, social and content.
- [SEO Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/seo-company-in-nagpur): Local SEO, technical SEO, content and AI-search (AEO) visibility, with a free instant audit.
- [Web Development Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/web-development-company-in-nagpur): Fast, SEO-ready websites and web applications built on a fixed price.
- [Website Design Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/website-design-company-in-nagpur): Conversion-focused website design.
- [Web App Development Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/web-app-development-company-in-nagpur): Custom web applications.
- [Shopify Development Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/shopify-development-company-in-nagpur): Shopify store design, build and optimisation.
- [Social Media Marketing Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/social-media-marketing-company-in-nagpur): Social media strategy, content and management.
- [Restaurant Marketing](https://timewheel.co.in/restaurant-marketing): Marketing for restaurants and cafes.
- [30 Days, 30 Websites](https://timewheel.co.in/30-days-30-websites): A challenge to build 30 websites in 30 days on a pay-what-you-want basis, including ₹0.

## Products
- [Book A Sloth](https://timewheel.co.in/products/book-a-sloth): An India-first appointment booking and scheduling platform Timewheel designed and built. 24/7 booking pages, UPI and Razorpay payments, two-way Google Calendar sync, WhatsApp and email reminders, GST invoicing, and a business dashboard. Live at https://bookasloth.com.
- [Alluminaty](https://timewheel.co.in/products/alluminaty): A social network for alumni that an institution owns under its own brand: a verified alumni directory, mentorship, jobs and referrals, chapters, events and reunions, and scholarship fundraising.
- [Ticket Dino](https://timewheel.co.in/products/ticket-dino): An event ticketing and management platform for organizers, covering ticket sales, attendee management and analytics. Launching soon.
- [Coffee & Toffee](https://timewheel.co.in/coffee-and-toffee): A creator monetization platform: accept coffees, toffees, memberships and shop sales from one page, with instant payouts and full ownership of the supporter list.
